Class Tribe

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.player.Tribe
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Tribe extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a player's collection of cards, split based on card type. Manages sub-list registrations via polymorphic overloads and exposes score helper methods for passive effects and endgame updates.
